title: Translate legacy IVR scripts into Connect flows
scenario: LFG runs Avaya CM vectors, an inherited Cisco UCCE/CVP routing script and a Five9 inbound IVR. The offshore migration factory will port about 140 scripts, so you build the translator from each export to a Connect flow and the proof that the translated flow treats every call the way the legacy script did.
task: Implement translateAvaya, translateCisco and translateFive9 (export text -> flow JSON) using the discovery mapping
Map holiday tables and time-of-day to hours of operation, announcements and microapps to prompts and input, queue steps to working queue + staffing check + priority + transfer
Fail loudly on constructs Connect cannot express
Document what does not translate 1:1 and how to run the migration factory
acceptance: Every translated flow is lint clean and starts with flow logging
Legacy interpreter and translated flow agree on outcome, queue, priority and prompt sequence over a matrix of times, holidays, staffing and key presses
Three unseen scripts in the same formats translate and match
